week_theme: This is a consolidation week in the forex calendar. The SNB and RBA hold decisions mid-week, but consensus figures and rate expectations are not yet published by major news outlets. The US and eurozone are quiet, with major data (US GDP, CPI, NFP, ECB/BOE decisions) pushed to the final week of September and into early October. Traders are in a holding pattern ahead of the central bank cascade that begins Sept 30.
peak_volatility_windows: Wednesday 10:00-11:00 UTC — SNB Rate Decision (CHF/USD, EUR/CHF likely to move 30–80 pips depending on surprise)
Thursday 09:00-10:30 UTC — RBA Rate Decision (AUD/USD likely to move 50–120 pips)
Thursday 10:30 UTC — Japan Services PMI (secondary move, JPY pairs minor impact)
agent_action: Reduce position size and tighten stops for CHF and AUD pairs through Wednesday/Thursday. Prepare SNB and RBA decision playbooks (rate expectations, current policy stance, key speaker quotes) now — consensus is sparse, so focus on central bank communications and market-implied rates via swaps. Stage long-dated USD shorts if Fed is on hold; stage EUR longs if ECB signals easing into Oct 29. Avoid binary risk in quiet US/EU pairs Mon–Tue; save dry powder for Sept 30 onwards when GDP/CPI and FOMC prep dominate.
